faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: The maximum group size is 12 passengers per boat, which applies to models like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86. Smaller boats carry fewer guests, so check each model's capacity.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for 8 people in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, many boats accommodate 8 guests, including the Bandido (8 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), and Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax). For a group of 8, the Bandido or Azimut 39 are excellent options.

faq.q: How many guests can the Astondoa 40 hold?

faq.q: Are there any boats for 5 people?

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden fees.

faq.q: How much does a group charter cost in Marbella?
faq.a: Tier A boats cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? Understanding marbella yacht charter group size limits is essential to match your party with the right boat. For 2030, our fleet in Puerto Banús carries between 5 and 12 passengers, with clear capacity caps per vessel. Whether you're a couple, a family, or a crew of friends, here's exactly how many guests each boat can take and what you'll pay.

Why Group Size Matters for Your Charter

Every boat has a legal passenger limit based on its size, safety equipment, and design. Exceeding that number isn't just uncomfortable — it's unsafe and illegal. In Marbella, the maximum for a private yacht charter is 12 guests, which applies to our largest models. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal for intimate trips. Always confirm your group size before booking to avoid disappointment.

Our Fleet: Passenger Capacities at a Glance

Below is the full list of boats available from Puerto Banús, with their maximum passenger numbers. All depart from Marbella's premier marina.

Pricing Tiers Based on Group Size

We offer two main pricing tiers. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, up to €2,299 for 8 hours — perfect for groups of 9–11. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, both white and grey) start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, including a free jet ski. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 is a popular choice. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp, so just ask.

What's Included in Every Charter

No matter which boat you choose, every booking includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras — just show up with your group and enjoy the Mediterranean.

Popular Routes for Groups of 5–12

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or head west to Estepona. Larger boats (12 pax) can comfortably reach Sotogrande or spend a day anchored near the Golden Mile. Smaller groups on the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 can explore the coastline at a relaxed pace, stopping for swims in secluded coves.

How to Book the Right Boat for Your Group

Ready to reserve? Check our full fleet and availability here. For groups of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer ample deck space. For 5–6 guests, the Dubhe or Speedboat are budget-friendly options. Need a custom quote? Message us on WhatsApp — we'll match your group size to the perfect boat.

Frequently asked questions

What is the maximum group size for a yacht charter in Marbella?

The maximum group size is 12 passengers per boat, which applies to models like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86. Smaller boats carry fewer guests, so check each model's capacity.

Can I charter a boat for 8 people in Marbella?

Yes, many boats accommodate 8 guests, including the Bandido (8 pax), Pershing 46 (10 pax), and Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax). For a group of 8, the Bandido or Azimut 39 are excellent options.

How many guests can the Astondoa 40 hold?

The Astondoa 40 holds up to 9 passengers. It's a 12.5m motor yacht departing Puerto Banús, priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full day, including skipper and refreshments.

Are there any boats for 5 people?

Yes, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect for small groups of 5. These are budget-friendly options starting from Puerto Banús.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden fees.

How much does a group charter cost in Marbella?

Tier A boats cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Do I need to pay extra for a skipper?

No, a licensed skipper is included in all our charter prices. You don't need a boating license or any extra fees for the crew.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

You're welcome to bring extra food or drinks, but we already provide a selection of beverages and snacks. Check with us if you have specific dietary needs.
